The US cohort's +5.58% breadth signals durable AI capex demand, not noise. Buy pullbacks in PLTR and MRVL; avoid INTC's structural foundry risk. Trim ID tech exposure to fund US AI leaders, targeting 20% overweight for 3-6 months.
